method.reads: Warm public queryUsagePage, first 100 rows plus grouped COUNT, same facts/SQL/build; two warmups; rotated/reversed order; GC outside timer; full SQL result and count equality before timing.
method.writes: One appended request through public replaceSessions including commit; restore identical pre-state for every sample; one warmup; indexes and ready daily rollups retained; open/backup/input/correctness excluded.
method.stats: Product PRAGMA main.optimize=0x10002 after index creation for ALL variants; no forced ANALYZE.
method.queryPrototype: shared-session-time rewrites only the rollup session-start MIN subquery at connection.prepare, so the public reader uses the raw time index for the same all-time minimum. No product file is modified. Full results and selected-session ranges are compared against unchanged SQL.
method.dates: Last 7/30 days ending at local midnight after latest recorded request, not wall clock today.
method.space: Checkpointed file bytes and dbstat object pages, no VACUUM; index creation may reuse existing free pages.
method.limits: DB only; no parsing/worker/UI/OS-cache reset; one machine and two synthetic distributions. Private paths/titles/session IDs omitted. Physical IDs/update timestamps ignored only in comparison hashes; floats rounded to 12 significant digits only for comparison.

sql.rows:
SELECT * FROM (
        SELECT
      provider,
      model,
      project_key,
      (SELECT project_name
        FROM projects p
        WHERE p.project_key = turn_summary.project_key) AS project_name,
      session_id,
      (SELECT session_name
        FROM sessions s
        WHERE s.provider = turn_summary.provider AND s.session_id = turn_summary.session_id) AS session_name,
      (SELECT MIN(d.min_started_at_ms)
        FROM usage_request_daily d
        WHERE d.provider = turn_summary.provider AND d.session_id = turn_summary.session_id) AS session_started_at_ms,
      NULL AS period,
      SUM(input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
      SUM(output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
      CASE
        WHEN SUM(cache_write_input_tokens_known) = SUM(turn_count)
        THEN SUM(cache_write_input_tokens)
      END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
      CASE
        WHEN SUM(cache_read_input_tokens_known) = SUM(turn_count)
        THEN SUM(cache_read_input_tokens)
      END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
      SUM(total_tokens) AS total_tokens,
      SUM(turn_count) AS turn_count,
      SUM(completed_turns) AS completed_turns,
      SUM(recorded_turns) AS recorded_turns,
      SUM(recorded_completed_turns) AS recorded_completed_turns,
      1.0 * SUM(r_total_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(recorded_completed_turns), 0) AS avg_tokens_per_turn,
      1.0 * SUM(r_input_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(recorded_completed_turns), 0) AS avg_input_tokens,
      1.0 * SUM(r_output_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(recorded_completed_turns), 0) AS avg_output_tokens,
      CASE
        WHEN SUM(r_cache_write_input_tokens_known) = SUM(recorded_completed_turns)
        THEN 1.0 * SUM(r_cache_write_input_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(recorded_completed_turns), 0)
      END AS avg_cache_write_input_tokens,
      CASE
        WHEN SUM(r_cache_read_input_tokens_known) = SUM(recorded_completed_turns)
        THEN 1.0 * SUM(r_cache_read_input_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(recorded_completed_turns), 0)
      END AS avg_cache_read_input_tokens,
      1.0 * SUM(r_duration_ms) / NULLIF(SUM(r_duration_ms_known), 0) AS avg_duration_ms,
      SUM(r_duration_ms_known) AS turns_with_duration,
      SUM(r_exact) AS exact_duration_turns,
      SUM(r_derived) AS derived_duration_turns,
      SUM(r_approximate) AS approximate_duration_turns,
      SUM(r_duration_missing) AS missing_duration_turns,
      SUM(unknown_time_turns) AS unknown_time_turns,
      SUM(stale_turns) AS stale_turns,
      MAX(last_successful_update) AS last_successful_update
    FROM (
      SELECT
      provider,
      project_key,
      session_id,
      local_day,
      model,
      model_key,
      input_tokens,
      output_tokens,
      total_tokens,
      turn_count,
      completed_turns,
      recorded_turns,
      recorded_completed_turns,
      cache_write_input_tokens,
      cache_write_input_tokens_known,
      cache_read_input_tokens,
      cache_read_input_tokens_known,
      c_input_tokens,
      c_output_tokens,
      c_total_tokens,
      c_cache_write_input_tokens,
      c_cache_write_input_tokens_known,
      c_cache_read_input_tokens,
      c_cache_read_input_tokens_known,
      c_duration_ms,
      c_duration_ms_known,
      c_exact,
      c_derived,
      c_approximate,
      c_duration_missing,
      r_input_tokens,
      r_output_tokens,
      r_total_tokens,
      r_cache_write_input_tokens,
      r_cache_write_input_tokens_known,
      r_cache_read_input_tokens,
      r_cache_read_input_tokens_known,
      r_duration_ms,
      r_duration_ms_known,
      r_exact,
      r_derived,
      r_approximate,
      r_duration_missing,
      unknown_time_turns,
      stale_turns,
      last_successful_update,
      min_started_at_ms
    FROM usage_model_daily AS turn_summary
    WHERE provider IN (?,?)
      AND ((local_day <> '') OR local_day = '')
    ) AS turn_summary
    GROUP BY provider, model, project_key, session_id
      )
    ORDER BY coalesce(model, '') = '', session_started_at_ms IS NULL, session_started_at_ms DESC, provider, model, project_key, session_id
    LIMIT ?
    OFFSET ?

      t.last_error,
      t.updated_at,
      CASE
  WHEN coalesce(m.model, '') = ''
    AND coalesce(m.input_tokens + m.output_tokens, t.total_tokens) = 0
  THEN NULL
  ELSE coalesce(m.model, '')
END AS model,
      
  coalesce(m.input_tokens, t.input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
  coalesce(m.output_tokens, t.output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
  CASE
    WHEN m.turn_id IS NULL THEN t.cache_write_input_tokens
    ELSE m.cache_write_input_tokens
  END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
  CASE
    WHEN m.turn_id IS NULL THEN t.cache_read_input_tokens
    ELSE m.cache_read_input_tokens
  END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
      coalesce(m.input_tokens + m.output_tokens, t.total_tokens) AS total_tokens
    FROM turn_summary t
    LEFT JOIN turn_model_usage m ON m.turn_id = t.id

  ) AS turn_summary

      LIMIT ?
      OFFSET ?

SELECT * FROM (
SELECT

      NULL AS session_id,
      NULL AS session_name,
      NULL AS session_started_at_ms,
      agent_tracker_period(started_at_ms, ?, ?) AS period,
      
    SUM(input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
    SUM(output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(cache_write_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_write_input_tokens)
    END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(cache_read_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_read_input_tokens)
    END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
    SUM(total_tokens) AS total_tokens,
    COUNT(*) AS turn_count,
    SUM(status = 'completed') AS completed_turns,
    SUM((total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_completed_turns,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN total_tokens END) AS avg_tokens_per_turn,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN input_tokens END) AS avg_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN output_tokens END) AS avg_output_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_read_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN duration_ms END) AS avg_duration_ms,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL) AS turns_with_duration,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'exact') AS exact_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'derived') AS derived_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'approximate') AS approximate_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NULL) AS missing_duration_turns,
    SUM(started_at_ms IS NULL) AS unknown_time_turns,
    SUM(last_error IS NOT NULL) AS stale_turns,
    MAX(updated_at) AS last_successful_update, 
  SUM(cost_usd) AS cost_usd,
  SUM(unknown_costs) AS unknown_costs,
  CASE
    WHEN min(billing_mode) = max(billing_mode) THEN min(billing_mode)
    ELSE 'unknown'
  END AS billing_mode
    FROM (
    SELECT
      t.*,
      EXISTS(
        SELECT 1
        FROM turn_model_usage m
        WHERE m.turn_id = t.id AND m.model <> ''
      ) AS has_model
    FROM (
    SELECT
      t.*,
      c.cost_usd,
      coalesce(c.unknown_costs, 1) AS unknown_costs,
      coalesce(c.billing_mode, 'unknown') AS billing_mode
    FROM turn_summary t
    LEFT JOIN turn_costs c ON c.turn_id = t.id
  ) t
  ) AS turn_summary
    WHERE provider IN (?,?)
    GROUP BY provider, period
    )
    ORDER BY period IS NULL, period IS NULL, period DESC, provider, project_key, session_id
    LIMIT ?

sql.rows:
SELECT * FROM (
SELECT
      provider,
      NULL AS project_key,
      NULL AS project_name,
      NULL AS session_id,
      NULL AS session_name,
      NULL AS session_started_at_ms,
      agent_tracker_period(started_at_ms, ?, ?) AS period,
      
    SUM(input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
    SUM(output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(cache_write_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_write_input_tokens)
    END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(cache_read_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_read_input_tokens)
    END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
    SUM(total_tokens) AS total_tokens,
    COUNT(*) AS turn_count,
    SUM(status = 'completed') AS completed_turns,
    SUM((total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_completed_turns,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN total_tokens END) AS avg_tokens_per_turn,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN input_tokens END) AS avg_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN output_tokens END) AS avg_output_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_read_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN duration_ms END) AS avg_duration_ms,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL) AS turns_with_duration,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'exact') AS exact_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'derived') AS derived_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'approximate') AS approximate_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NULL) AS missing_duration_turns,
    SUM(started_at_ms IS NULL) AS unknown_time_turns,
    SUM(last_error IS NOT NULL) AS stale_turns,
    MAX(updated_at) AS last_successful_update, 
  SUM(cost_usd) AS cost_usd,
  SUM(unknown_costs) AS unknown_costs,
  CASE
    WHEN min(billing_mode) = max(billing_mode) THEN min(billing_mode)
    ELSE 'unknown'
  END AS billing_mode
    FROM (
    SELECT
      t.*,
      EXISTS(
        SELECT 1
        FROM turn_model_usage m
        WHERE m.turn_id = t.id AND m.model <> ''
      ) AS has_model
    FROM (
    SELECT
      t.*,
      c.cost_usd,
      coalesce(c.unknown_costs, 1) AS unknown_costs,
      coalesce(c.billing_mode, 'unknown') AS billing_mode
    FROM turn_summary t
    LEFT JOIN turn_costs c ON c.turn_id = t.id
  ) t
  ) AS turn_summary
    WHERE provider IN (?,?) AND provider = ? AND project_key = ? AND (started_at_ms >= ? AND started_at_ms < ?)
    GROUP BY provider, period
    )
    ORDER BY period IS NULL, period IS NULL, period DESC, provider, project_key, session_id
    LIMIT ?
    OFFSET ?

sql.rows:
SELECT * FROM (
SELECT
      provider,
      model,
      NULL AS project_key,
      NULL AS project_name,
      NULL AS session_id,
      NULL AS session_name,
      NULL AS session_started_at_ms,
      agent_tracker_period(started_at_ms, ?, ?) AS period,
      
    SUM(input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
    SUM(output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(cache_write_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_write_input_tokens)
    END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(cache_read_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_read_input_tokens)
    END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
    SUM(total_tokens) AS total_tokens,
    COUNT(*) AS turn_count,
    SUM(status = 'completed') AS completed_turns,
    SUM((total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_completed_turns,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN total_tokens END) AS avg_tokens_per_turn,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN input_tokens END) AS avg_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN output_tokens END) AS avg_output_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_read_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN duration_ms END) AS avg_duration_ms,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL) AS turns_with_duration,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'exact') AS exact_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'derived') AS derived_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'approximate') AS approximate_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NULL) AS missing_duration_turns,
    SUM(started_at_ms IS NULL) AS unknown_time_turns,
    SUM(last_error IS NOT NULL) AS stale_turns,
    MAX(updated_at) AS last_successful_update, 
  SUM(cost_usd) AS cost_usd,
  SUM(unknown_costs) AS unknown_costs,
  CASE
    WHEN min(billing_mode) = max(billing_mode) THEN min(billing_mode)
    ELSE 'unknown'
  END AS billing_mode
    FROM (
    SELECT
      t.id,
      t.provider,
      t.project_key,
      t.session_id,
      t.root_turn_id,
      t.request_title,
      coalesce(m.model, '') <> '' AS has_model,
      t.started_at_ms,
      t.completed_at_ms,
      t.duration_ms,
      t.duration_quality,
      t.status,
      t.quality_flags,
      t.diagnostic_file_id,
      t.diagnostic_offset,
      t.last_error,
      t.updated_at,
      CASE
  WHEN coalesce(m.model, '') = ''
    AND coalesce(m.input_tokens + m.output_tokens, t.total_tokens) = 0
  THEN NULL
  ELSE coalesce(m.model, '')
END AS model,
      
  coalesce(m.input_tokens, t.input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
  coalesce(m.output_tokens, t.output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
  CASE
    WHEN m.turn_id IS NULL THEN t.cache_write_input_tokens
    ELSE m.cache_write_input_tokens
  END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
  CASE
    WHEN m.turn_id IS NULL THEN t.cache_read_input_tokens
    ELSE m.cache_read_input_tokens
  END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
      coalesce(m.input_tokens + m.output_tokens, t.total_tokens) AS total_tokens, 
  coalesce(c.billing_mode, 'unknown') AS billing_mode,
  CASE
    WHEN c.billing_mode = 'subscription' THEN 0
    WHEN c.billing_mode = 'api' THEN m.estimated_cost_usd
  END AS cost_usd,
  CASE
    WHEN c.billing_mode = 'subscription'
      OR c.billing_mode = 'api' AND m.estimated_cost_usd IS NOT NULL
    THEN 0
    ELSE 1
  END AS unknown_costs
    FROM turn_summary t
    LEFT JOIN turn_model_usage m ON m.turn_id = t.id
    LEFT JOIN turn_costs c ON c.turn_id = t.id
  ) AS turn_summary
    WHERE provider IN (?,?)
    GROUP BY provider, model, period
    )
    ORDER BY (period IS NULL OR coalesce(model, '') = ''), period IS NULL, coalesce(model, '') = '', period IS NULL, period DESC, provider, model, project_key, session_id
    LIMIT ?
    OFFSET ?

      t.diagnostic_offset,
      t.last_error,
      t.updated_at,
      CASE
  WHEN coalesce(m.model, '') = ''
    AND coalesce(m.input_tokens + m.output_tokens, t.total_tokens) = 0
  THEN NULL
  ELSE coalesce(m.model, '')
END AS model,
      
  coalesce(m.input_tokens, t.input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
  coalesce(m.output_tokens, t.output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
  CASE
    WHEN m.turn_id IS NULL THEN t.cache_write_input_tokens
    ELSE m.cache_write_input_tokens
  END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
  CASE
    WHEN m.turn_id IS NULL THEN t.cache_read_input_tokens
    ELSE m.cache_read_input_tokens

SELECT * FROM (
SELECT
      provider,
      model,
      project_key,
      (
        SELECT project_name
        FROM projects p
        WHERE p.project_key = turn_summary.project_key
      ) AS project_name,
      session_id,
      (
        SELECT session_name
        FROM sessions s
        WHERE s.provider = turn_summary.provider AND s.session_id = turn_summary.session_id
      ) AS session_name,
      (
        SELECT MIN(t.started_at_ms)
        FROM turn_summary t
        WHERE t.provider = turn_summary.provider AND t.session_id = turn_summary.session_id
      ) AS session_started_at_ms,
      NULL AS period,
      
    SUM(input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
    SUM(output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(cache_write_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_write_input_tokens)
    END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(cache_read_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_read_input_tokens)
    END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
    SUM(total_tokens) AS total_tokens,
    COUNT(*) AS turn_count,
    SUM(status = 'completed') AS completed_turns,
    SUM((total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_completed_turns,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN total_tokens END) AS avg_tokens_per_turn,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN input_tokens END) AS avg_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN output_tokens END) AS avg_output_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_read_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN duration_ms END) AS avg_duration_ms,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL) AS turns_with_duration,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'exact') AS exact_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'derived') AS derived_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'approximate') AS approximate_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NULL) AS missing_duration_turns,
    SUM(started_at_ms IS NULL) AS unknown_time_turns,
    SUM(last_error IS NOT NULL) AS stale_turns,
    MAX(updated_at) AS last_successful_update, 
  SUM(cost_usd) AS cost_usd,
  SUM(unknown_costs) AS unknown_costs,
  CASE
    WHEN min(billing_mode) = max(billing_mode) THEN min(billing_mode)
    ELSE 'unknown'
  END AS billing_mode
    FROM (
    SELECT
      t.id,
      t.provider,
      t.project_key,
      t.session_id,
      t.root_turn_id,
      t.request_title,
      coalesce(m.model, '') <> '' AS has_model,
      t.started_at_ms,
      t.completed_at_ms,
      t.duration_ms,
      t.duration_quality,
      t.status,
      t.quality_flags,
      t.diagnostic_file_id,
      t.diagnostic_offset,
      t.last_error,
      t.updated_at,
      CASE
  WHEN coalesce(m.model, '') = ''
    AND coalesce(m.input_tokens + m.output_tokens, t.total_tokens) = 0
  THEN NULL
  ELSE coalesce(m.model, '')
END AS model,
      
  coalesce(m.input_tokens, t.input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
  coalesce(m.output_tokens, t.output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
  CASE
    WHEN m.turn_id IS NULL THEN t.cache_write_input_tokens
    ELSE m.cache_write_input_tokens
  END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
  CASE
    WHEN m.turn_id IS NULL THEN t.cache_read_input_tokens
    ELSE m.cache_read_input_tokens
  END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
      coalesce(m.input_tokens + m.output_tokens, t.total_tokens) AS total_tokens, 
  coalesce(c.billing_mode, 'unknown') AS billing_mode,
  CASE
    WHEN c.billing_mode = 'subscription' THEN 0
    WHEN c.billing_mode = 'api' THEN m.estimated_cost_usd
  END AS cost_usd,
  CASE
    WHEN c.billing_mode = 'subscription'
      OR c.billing_mode = 'api' AND m.estimated_cost_usd IS NOT NULL
    THEN 0
    ELSE 1
  END AS unknown_costs
    FROM turn_summary t
    LEFT JOIN turn_model_usage m ON m.turn_id = t.id
    LEFT JOIN turn_costs c ON c.turn_id = t.id
  ) AS turn_summary
    WHERE provider IN (?,?) AND provider = ? AND session_id = ? AND (started_at_ms >= ? AND started_at_ms < ?)
    GROUP BY provider, model, project_key, session_id
    )
    ORDER BY coalesce(model, '') = '', session_started_at_ms IS NULL, session_started_at_ms DESC, provider, model, project_key, session_id
    LIMIT ?
    OFFSET ?

        SELECT
      provider,
      model,
      project_key,
      (SELECT project_name
        FROM projects p
        WHERE p.project_key = turn_summary.project_key) AS project_name,
      session_id,
      (SELECT session_name
        FROM sessions s
        WHERE s.provider = turn_summary.provider AND s.session_id = turn_summary.session_id) AS session_name,
      (SELECT MIN(d.started_at_ms) FROM turn_summary d WHERE d.provider = turn_summary.provider AND d.session_id = turn_summary.session_id) AS session_started_at_ms,
      NULL AS period,
      SUM(input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
      SUM(output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
      CASE
        WHEN SUM(cache_write_input_tokens_known) = SUM(turn_count)
        THEN SUM(cache_write_input_tokens)
      END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
      CASE
        WHEN SUM(cache_read_input_tokens_known) = SUM(turn_count)
        THEN SUM(cache_read_input_tokens)
      END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
      SUM(total_tokens) AS total_tokens,
      SUM(turn_count) AS turn_count,
      SUM(completed_turns) AS completed_turns,
      SUM(recorded_turns) AS recorded_turns,
      SUM(recorded_completed_turns) AS recorded_completed_turns,
      1.0 * SUM(r_total_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(recorded_completed_turns), 0) AS avg_tokens_per_turn,
      1.0 * SUM(r_input_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(recorded_completed_turns), 0) AS avg_input_tokens,
      1.0 * SUM(r_output_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(recorded_completed_turns), 0) AS avg_output_tokens,
      CASE
        WHEN SUM(r_cache_write_input_tokens_known) = SUM(recorded_completed_turns)
        THEN 1.0 * SUM(r_cache_write_input_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(recorded_completed_turns), 0)
      END AS avg_cache_write_input_tokens,
      CASE
        WHEN SUM(r_cache_read_input_tokens_known) = SUM(recorded_completed_turns)
        THEN 1.0 * SUM(r_cache_read_input_tokens) / NULLIF(SUM(recorded_completed_turns), 0)
      END AS avg_cache_read_input_tokens,
      1.0 * SUM(r_duration_ms) / NULLIF(SUM(r_duration_ms_known), 0) AS avg_duration_ms,
      SUM(r_duration_ms_known) AS turns_with_duration,
      SUM(r_exact) AS exact_duration_turns,
      SUM(r_derived) AS derived_duration_turns,
      SUM(r_approximate) AS approximate_duration_turns,
      SUM(r_duration_missing) AS missing_duration_turns,
      SUM(unknown_time_turns) AS unknown_time_turns,
      SUM(stale_turns) AS stale_turns,
      MAX(last_successful_update) AS last_successful_update
    FROM (
      SELECT
      provider,
      project_key,
      session_id,
      local_day,
      model,
      model_key,
      input_tokens,
      output_tokens,
      total_tokens,
      turn_count,
      completed_turns,
      recorded_turns,
      recorded_completed_turns,
      cache_write_input_tokens,
      cache_write_input_tokens_known,
      cache_read_input_tokens,
      cache_read_input_tokens_known,
      c_input_tokens,
      c_output_tokens,
      c_total_tokens,
      c_cache_write_input_tokens,
      c_cache_write_input_tokens_known,
      c_cache_read_input_tokens,
      c_cache_read_input_tokens_known,
      c_duration_ms,
      c_duration_ms_known,
      c_exact,
      c_derived,
      c_approximate,
      c_duration_missing,
      r_input_tokens,
      r_output_tokens,
      r_total_tokens,
      r_cache_write_input_tokens,
      r_cache_write_input_tokens_known,
      r_cache_read_input_tokens,
      r_cache_read_input_tokens_known,
      r_duration_ms,
      r_duration_ms_known,
      r_exact,
      r_derived,
      r_approximate,
      r_duration_missing,
      unknown_time_turns,
      stale_turns,
      last_successful_update,
      min_started_at_ms
    FROM usage_model_daily AS turn_summary
    WHERE provider IN (?,?)
      AND ((local_day <> '') OR local_day = '')
    ) AS turn_summary
    GROUP BY provider, model, project_key, session_id
      )
    ORDER BY coalesce(model, '') = '', session_started_at_ms IS NULL, session_started_at_ms DESC, provider, model, project_key, session_id
    LIMIT ?
    OFFSET ?

      FROM (
    SELECT
      t.*,
      p.project_name,
      s.session_name
    FROM (
    SELECT
      t.id,
      t.provider,
      t.project_key,
      t.session_id,
      t.root_turn_id,
      t.request_title,
      coalesce(m.model, '') <> '' AS has_model,
      t.started_at_ms,
      t.completed_at_ms,
      t.duration_ms,
      t.duration_quality,
      t.status,
      t.quality_flags,
      t.diagnostic_file_id,
      t.diagnostic_offset,
      t.last_error,
      t.updated_at,
      CASE
  WHEN coalesce(m.model, '') = ''
    AND coalesce(m.input_tokens + m.output_tokens, t.total_tokens) = 0
  THEN NULL
  ELSE coalesce(m.model, '')
END AS model,
      
  coalesce(m.input_tokens, t.input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
  coalesce(m.output_tokens, t.output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
  CASE
    WHEN m.turn_id IS NULL THEN t.cache_write_input_tokens
    ELSE m.cache_write_input_tokens
  END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
  CASE
    WHEN m.turn_id IS NULL THEN t.cache_read_input_tokens
    ELSE m.cache_read_input_tokens
  END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
      coalesce(m.input_tokens + m.output_tokens, t.total_tokens) AS total_tokens
    FROM turn_summary t
    LEFT JOIN turn_model_usage m ON m.turn_id = t.id
    
  ) t
    JOIN projects p ON p.project_key = t.project_key
    JOIN sessions s ON s.provider = t.provider AND s.session_id = t.session_id
  ) AS turn_summary
      WHERE provider IN (?,?) AND id > ?
      ORDER BY (started_at_ms IS NULL OR coalesce(model, '') = ''), started_at_ms IS NULL, coalesce(model, '') = '', started_at_ms IS NULL, started_at_ms DESC, provider, model, id
      LIMIT ?
      OFFSET ?

SELECT * FROM (
SELECT
      provider,
      NULL AS project_key,
      NULL AS project_name,
      NULL AS session_id,
      NULL AS session_name,
      NULL AS session_started_at_ms,
      agent_tracker_period(started_at_ms, ?, ?) AS period,
      
    SUM(input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
    SUM(output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(cache_write_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_write_input_tokens)
    END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(cache_read_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_read_input_tokens)
    END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
    SUM(total_tokens) AS total_tokens,
    COUNT(*) AS turn_count,
    SUM(status = 'completed') AS completed_turns,
    SUM((total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_completed_turns,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN total_tokens END) AS avg_tokens_per_turn,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN input_tokens END) AS avg_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN output_tokens END) AS avg_output_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_read_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN duration_ms END) AS avg_duration_ms,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL) AS turns_with_duration,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'exact') AS exact_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'derived') AS derived_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'approximate') AS approximate_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NULL) AS missing_duration_turns,
    SUM(started_at_ms IS NULL) AS unknown_time_turns,
    SUM(last_error IS NOT NULL) AS stale_turns,
    MAX(updated_at) AS last_successful_update, 
  SUM(cost_usd) AS cost_usd,
  SUM(unknown_costs) AS unknown_costs,
  CASE
    WHEN min(billing_mode) = max(billing_mode) THEN min(billing_mode)
    ELSE 'unknown'
  END AS billing_mode
    FROM (
    SELECT
      t.*,
      EXISTS(
        SELECT 1
        FROM turn_model_usage m
        WHERE m.turn_id = t.id AND m.model <> ''
      ) AS has_model
    FROM (
    SELECT
      t.*,
      c.cost_usd,
      coalesce(c.unknown_costs, 1) AS unknown_costs,
      coalesce(c.billing_mode, 'unknown') AS billing_mode
    FROM turn_summary t
    LEFT JOIN turn_costs c ON c.turn_id = t.id
  ) t
  ) AS turn_summary
    WHERE provider IN (?,?)
    GROUP BY provider, period
    )
    ORDER BY period IS NULL, period IS NULL, period DESC, provider, project_key, session_id
    LIMIT ?
    OFFSET ?

sql.rows:
SELECT * FROM (
SELECT
      provider,
      project_key,
      (
        SELECT project_name
        FROM projects p
        WHERE p.project_key = turn_summary.project_key
      ) AS project_name,
      session_id,
      (
        SELECT session_name
        FROM sessions s
        WHERE s.provider = turn_summary.provider AND s.session_id = turn_summary.session_id
      ) AS session_name,
      (
        SELECT MIN(t.started_at_ms)
        FROM turn_summary t
        WHERE t.provider = turn_summary.provider AND t.session_id = turn_summary.session_id
      ) AS session_started_at_ms,
      NULL AS period,
      
    SUM(input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
    SUM(output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(cache_write_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_write_input_tokens)
    END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(cache_read_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_read_input_tokens)
    END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
    SUM(total_tokens) AS total_tokens,
    COUNT(*) AS turn_count,
    SUM(status = 'completed') AS completed_turns,
    SUM((total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_completed_turns,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN total_tokens END) AS avg_tokens_per_turn,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN input_tokens END) AS avg_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN output_tokens END) AS avg_output_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_read_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN duration_ms END) AS avg_duration_ms,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL) AS turns_with_duration,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'exact') AS exact_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'derived') AS derived_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'approximate') AS approximate_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NULL) AS missing_duration_turns,
    SUM(started_at_ms IS NULL) AS unknown_time_turns,
    SUM(last_error IS NOT NULL) AS stale_turns,
    MAX(updated_at) AS last_successful_update, 
  SUM(cost_usd) AS cost_usd,
  SUM(unknown_costs) AS unknown_costs,
  CASE
    WHEN min(billing_mode) = max(billing_mode) THEN min(billing_mode)
    ELSE 'unknown'
  END AS billing_mode
    FROM (
    SELECT
      t.*,
      EXISTS(
        SELECT 1
        FROM turn_model_usage m
        WHERE m.turn_id = t.id AND m.model <> ''
      ) AS has_model
    FROM (
    SELECT
      t.*,
      c.cost_usd,
      coalesce(c.unknown_costs, 1) AS unknown_costs,
      coalesce(c.billing_mode, 'unknown') AS billing_mode
    FROM turn_summary t
    LEFT JOIN turn_costs c ON c.turn_id = t.id
  ) t
  ) AS turn_summary
    WHERE provider IN (?,?)
    GROUP BY provider, project_key, session_id
    )
    ORDER BY session_started_at_ms IS NULL, session_started_at_ms DESC, provider, project_key, session_id
    LIMIT ?
    OFFSET ?

    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END)

    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_completed_turns,

    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_read_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN duration_ms END) AS avg_duration_ms,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL) AS turns_with_duration,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'exact') AS exact_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'derived') AS derived_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'approximate') AS approximate_duration_turns,

    WHEN min(billing_mode) = max(billing_mode) THEN min(billing_mode)
    ELSE 'unknown'

      t.project_key,
      t.session_id,
      t.root_turn_id,
      t.request_title,

      t.completed_at_ms,
      t.duration_ms,
      t.duration_quality,
      t.status,
      t.quality_flags,
      t.diagnostic_file_id,
      t.diagnostic_offset,
      t.last_error,

  WHEN coalesce(m.model, '') = ''

END AS model,

SELECT
        *,
        (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AS has_recorded_usage
      FROM (
    SELECT
      t.*,
      p.project_name,
      s.session_name
    FROM (
    SELECT
      t.id,
      t.provider,
      t.project_key,
      t.session_id,
      t.root_turn_id,
      t.request_title,
      coalesce(m.model, '') <> '' AS has_model,
      t.started_at_ms,
      t.completed_at_ms,
      t.duration_ms,
      t.duration_quality,
      t.status,
      t.quality_flags,
      t.diagnostic_file_id,
      t.diagnostic_offset,
      t.last_error,
      t.updated_at,
      CASE
  WHEN coalesce(m.model, '') = ''
    AND coalesce(m.input_tokens + m.output_tokens, t.total_tokens) = 0
  THEN NULL
  ELSE coalesce(m.model, '')
END AS model,
      
  coalesce(m.input_tokens, t.input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
  coalesce(m.output_tokens, t.output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
  CASE
    WHEN m.turn_id IS NULL THEN t.cache_write_input_tokens
    ELSE m.cache_write_input_tokens
  END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
  CASE
    WHEN m.turn_id IS NULL THEN t.cache_read_input_tokens
    ELSE m.cache_read_input_tokens
  END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
      coalesce(m.input_tokens + m.output_tokens, t.total_tokens) AS total_tokens
    FROM turn_summary t
    LEFT JOIN turn_model_usage m ON m.turn_id = t.id
    
  ) t
    JOIN projects p ON p.project_key = t.project_key
    JOIN sessions s ON s.provider = t.provider AND s.session_id = t.session_id
  ) AS turn_summary
      WHERE provider IN (?,?) AND id > ?
      ORDER BY (started_at_ms IS NULL OR coalesce(model, '') = ''), started_at_ms IS NULL, coalesce(model, '') = '', started_at_ms IS NULL, started_at_ms DESC, provider, model, id
      LIMIT ?
      OFFSET ?

    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_write_input_tokens,

    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_read_input_tokens,

    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL) AS turns_with_duration,

sql.rows:
SELECT * FROM (
SELECT
      provider,
      NULL AS project_key,
      NULL AS project_name,
      NULL AS session_id,
      NULL AS session_name,
      NULL AS session_started_at_ms,
      NULL AS period,
      
    SUM(input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
    SUM(output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(cache_write_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_write_input_tokens)
    END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(cache_read_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_read_input_tokens)
    END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
    SUM(total_tokens) AS total_tokens,
    COUNT(*) AS turn_count,
    SUM(status = 'completed') AS completed_turns,
    SUM((total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_completed_turns,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN total_tokens END) AS avg_tokens_per_turn,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN input_tokens END) AS avg_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN output_tokens END) AS avg_output_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_read_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN duration_ms END) AS avg_duration_ms,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL) AS turns_with_duration,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'exact') AS exact_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'derived') AS derived_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'approximate') AS approximate_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NULL) AS missing_duration_turns,
    SUM(started_at_ms IS NULL) AS unknown_time_turns,
    SUM(last_error IS NOT NULL) AS stale_turns,
    MAX(updated_at) AS last_successful_update, 
  SUM(cost_usd) AS cost_usd,
  SUM(unknown_costs) AS unknown_costs,
  CASE
    WHEN min(billing_mode) = max(billing_mode) THEN min(billing_mode)
    ELSE 'unknown'
  END AS billing_mode
    FROM (
    SELECT
      t.*,
      EXISTS(
        SELECT 1
        FROM turn_model_usage m
        WHERE m.turn_id = t.id AND m.model <> ''
      ) AS has_model
    FROM (
    SELECT
      t.*,
      c.cost_usd,
      coalesce(c.unknown_costs, 1) AS unknown_costs,
      coalesce(c.billing_mode, 'unknown') AS billing_mode
    FROM turn_summary t
    LEFT JOIN turn_costs c ON c.turn_id = t.id
  ) t
  ) AS turn_summary
    WHERE provider IN (?,?) AND (started_at_ms >= ? AND started_at_ms < ?)
    GROUP BY provider
    )
    ORDER BY provider IS NULL, provider DESC, provider, project_key, session_id
    LIMIT ?
    OFFSET ?

SELECT * FROM (

        FROM projects p
        WHERE p.project_key = turn_summary.project_key

      (
        SELECT session_name
        FROM sessions s
        WHERE s.provider = turn_summary.provider AND s.session_id = turn_summary.session_id
      ) AS session_name,
      (
        SELECT MIN(t.started_at_ms)
        FROM turn_summary t
        WHERE t.provider = turn_summary.provider AND t.session_id = turn_summary.session_id
      ) AS session_started_at_ms,
      NULL AS period,
      
    SUM(input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
    SUM(output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(cache_write_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_write_input_tokens)
    END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(cache_read_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_read_input_tokens)
    END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
    SUM(total_tokens) AS total_tokens,
    COUNT(*) AS turn_count,
    SUM(status = 'completed') AS completed_turns,
    SUM((total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_completed_turns,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN total_tokens END) AS avg_tokens_per_turn,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN input_tokens END) AS avg_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN output_tokens END) AS avg_output_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_read_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN duration_ms END) AS avg_duration_ms,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL) AS turns_with_duration,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'exact') AS exact_duration_turns,

        FROM turn_summary t
        WHERE t.provider = turn_summary.provider AND t.session_id = turn_summary.session_id

      NULL AS period,
      
    SUM(input_tokens) AS input_tokens,

    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(cache_write_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_write_input_tokens)
    END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(cache_read_input_tokens) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cache_read_input_tokens)
    END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
    SUM(total_tokens) AS total_tokens,
    COUNT(*) AS turn_count,
    SUM(status = 'completed') AS completed_turns,
    SUM((total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1)) AS recorded_completed_turns,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN total_tokens END) AS avg_tokens_per_turn,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN input_tokens END) AS avg_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN output_tokens END) AS avg_output_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_write_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_write_input_tokens,
    CASE
    WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END) = SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1))
    THEN AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN cache_read_input_tokens END)
  END AS avg_cache_read_input_tokens,
    AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) THEN duration_ms END) AS avg_duration_ms,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL) AS turns_with_duration,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'exact') AS exact_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'derived') AS derived_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_quality = 'approximate') AS approximate_duration_turns,
    SUM(status = 'completed' AND (total_tokens > 0 OR has_model = 1) AND duration_ms IS NULL) AS missing_duration_turns,
    SUM(started_at_ms IS NULL) AS unknown_time_turns,
    SUM(last_error IS NOT NULL) AS stale_turns,
    MAX(updated_at) AS last_successful_update,

    LIMIT ?

      t.completed_at_ms,
      t.duration_ms,
      t.duration_quality,
      t.status,
      t.quality_flags,
      t.diagnostic_file_id,
      t.diagnostic_offset,
      t.last_error,
      t.updated_at,
      CASE
  WHEN coalesce(m.model, '') = ''
    AND coalesce(m.input_tokens + m.output_tokens, t.total_tokens) = 0
  THEN NULL
  ELSE coalesce(m.model, '')
END AS model,
      
  coalesce(m.input_tokens, t.input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
  coalesce(m.output_tokens, t.output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
  CASE
    WHEN m.turn_id IS NULL THEN t.cache_write_input_tokens
    ELSE m.cache_write_input_tokens
  END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
  CASE
    WHEN m.turn_id IS NULL THEN t.cache_read_input_tokens
    ELSE m.cache_read_input_tokens
  END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
      coalesce(m.input_tokens + m.output_tokens, t.total_tokens) AS total_tokens, 
  coalesce(c.billing_mode, 'unknown') AS billing_mode,
  CASE
    WHEN c.billing_mode = 'subscription' THEN 0
    WHEN c.billing_mode = 'api' THEN m.estimated_cost_usd
  END AS cost_usd,
  CASE
    WHEN c.billing_mode = 'subscription'
      OR c.billing_mode = 'api' AND m.estimated_cost_usd IS NOT NULL
    THEN 0
    ELSE 1
  END AS unknown_costs
    FROM turn_summary t
    LEFT JOIN turn_model_usage m ON m.turn_id = t.id
    LEFT JOIN turn_costs c ON c.turn_id = t.id
  ) t
    JOIN projects p ON p.project_key = t.project_key
    JOIN sessions s ON s.provider = t.provider AND s.session_id = t.session_id
  ) AS turn_summary
      WHERE provider IN (?,?) AND id > ?
      ORDER BY (started_at_ms IS NULL OR coalesce(model, '') = ''), started_at_ms IS NULL, coalesce(model, '') = '', started_at_ms IS NULL, started_at_ms DESC, provider, model, id
      LIMIT ?
      OFFSET ?

      CASE
  WHEN coalesce(m.model, '') = ''
    AND coalesce(m.input_tokens + m.output_tokens, t.total_tokens) = 0
  THEN NULL
  ELSE coalesce(m.model, '')
END AS model,
      
  coalesce(m.input_tokens, t.input_tokens) AS input_tokens,
  coalesce(m.output_tokens, t.output_tokens) AS output_tokens,
  CASE
    WHEN m.turn_id IS NULL THEN t.cache_write_input_tokens
    ELSE m.cache_write_input_tokens
  END AS cache_write_input_tokens,
  CASE
    WHEN m.turn_id IS NULL THEN t.cache_read_input_tokens
    ELSE m.cache_read_input_tokens
  END AS cache_read_input_tokens,
      coalesce(m.input_tokens + m.output_tokens, t.total_tokens) AS total_tokens
    FROM turn_summary t
    LEFT JOIN turn_model_usage m ON m.turn_id = t.id
    
  ) AS turn_summary
